verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for an agentic coding workbench, but the evidence shows no way to issue least-privilege or scoped API credentials for an agent. The only credential-related feature is a single access token for the LAN web UI (set via --token or disabled via --no-token), which is an adjacent authentication control with no scoping or per-agent permissions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
